group: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
title: Award of Agreement Between Owner and Contractor – Competitively Bid –Sankofa Academy Boiler Replacement Project – Bay City Boiler & Engineering Co., Inc. – Division of Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Award of Agreement Between Owner and Contractor - Competitively Bid - to Bay City Engineering Company, Inc. (“Contractor”), Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide abatement and demolition of existing boiler and install two (2) Weil McLain Cast Iron Sectional  Boilers 1378 MHP input, for the Sankofa Academy Boiler Replacement Project, in the amount of $195,000.00, as the lowest responsive and responsible bidder, and rejecting all other bids, if any, and authorizing the President and Secretary of the Board to sign the Agreement for same with said bidder with work scheduled to commence on April 8, 2020, and scheduled to last for Ninety (90) Calendar days, and conclude on July 7, 2020, pursuant to the Agreement.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Awards Bay City $195,000 to replace the Sankofa Academy boilers, lowest bid
summary: The Board picks Bay City Engineering Company as the lowest responsive and responsible bidder to remove the old boiler and install two new boilers at Sankofa Academy. The contract is for $195,000. Work is scheduled to run 90 days, from April 8 to July 7, 2020.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

group: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
title: Amendment No. 1, Agreement for Inspector of Record Services - Anthonio, Inc. - Emerson Elementary School Softball Field Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Amendment No. 1, Agreement for Inspector of Record Services (IOR) between the District and Anthonio, Inc., Oakland CA, for the latter to provide additional IOR services to include changes to DSA required class - 1 IOR instead of class 3 shown in the drawings, pursuant to attached proposal dated 3-12-2020, for the Emerson Elementary School Softball Field Project, in an additional amount of $12,771.00 (includes a $6,831.00 contingency allowance), increasing Agreement not to exceed amount from $39,600.00 to $52,371.00, extending the term of Agreement from December 12, 2019 to March 11, 2020 to December 3, 2020, and authorizing the President and Secretary of the Board to sign the Amendment for same with said Consultant. All other terms and conditions of the Agreement remain in full force and effect.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Adds $12,771 and time for Anthonio, Inc.'s inspections at Emerson's softball field
summary: This amendment adds $12,771 (including a $6,831 contingency allowance) for Anthonio, Inc., which inspects construction on behalf of the district. The change covers a higher-level inspector class required by the Division of the State Architect (DSA), the state agency that reviews school construction. The contract limit rises from $39,600 to $52,371, and the term now runs to December 3, 2020.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

group: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
title: Award of Agreement Between Owner and Contractor - Competitively Bid – Bay Construction Company – Elmhurst Middle School Sewer Line Replacement Project - Division of Facilities Planning & Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Award of Agreement Between Owner and Contractor - Competitively Bid - to Bay Construction Company (“Contractor”), Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide construction services to include repair and replace 6”sewer main from main school building  and portables to the city street, replace all concrete and asphalt affected by pipe replacement, for the Elmhurst Middle School Sewer Line Replacement Project, in the amount of $220,000.00, as the lowest responsive and responsible bidder, and rejecting all other bids if any, and authorizing the President and Secretary of the Board to sign the Agreement for same with said bidder with work scheduled to commence on April 8, 2020, and scheduled to last for Ninety (90) Calendar days, concluding July 7, 2020.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Awards Bay Construction Company $220,000 to replace the Elmhurst Middle School sewer line
summary: The Board picks Bay Construction Company as the lowest responsive and responsible bidder to repair and replace the 6-inch sewer main from the main building and portables to the city street. The work also covers replacing concrete and asphalt affected by the pipe work. The contract is for $220,000, with work scheduled from April 8 to July 7, 2020.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Amendment No. 1, Professional Services Contract - TeachBar - Talent / Human Resources Department
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of Amendment No. 1, Professional Services Contract between the District and TeachBar, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide test preparation and tutoring services for teacher candidates to pass the California Basic Educational Skills Test (CBEST) and California Subject Examinations for Teachers (CSET), multiple subject/math, exams from 16 to 24, in the additional amount of $24,800.00, increasing the Contract not to exceed amount from $37,976.00 to $62,776.00, for the term August 1, 2019 through June 30, 2020.  All other terms and conditions of the Contract remain in full force and effect.
headline: Adds $24,800 to TeachBar's test prep and tutoring for teacher candidates
summary: This amendment adds $24,800 to the TeachBar contract, which provides test preparation and tutoring so teacher candidates can pass two state teaching exams, the CBEST and the CSET. The contract limit rises from $37,976 to $62,776, with the number of candidates going from 16 to 24. The term started August 1, 2019, so the Board is approving it after work began.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Layoffs/Additions/Net of Classified Positions for Fiscal Year 2020-2021
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Resolution No. 1920-2026 - Layoffs/Additions/Net of Classified Positions for Fiscal Year 2020-2021 which provides for the reduction or layoff of classified positions, and increase or creation of authorized classified positions based on lack of funds and/or program need consistent with Resolution No. 1920-0214 (Legislative File No. 20-0180, Enactment No. 20-0391, March 4, 2020) and as reflected through the Budget Development process for 2020-2021.
headline: Approves layoffs and added classified staff positions for the 2020-21 budget
summary: This resolution reduces or lays off some classified (non-teaching) positions and adds or creates others for fiscal year 2020-2021, based on lack of funds or program need. It follows an earlier March 2020 resolution and the budget development process. The text gives no dollar amount or list of positions.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Amendment, Grant Award - California Department of Social Services - Refugee Programs Bureau - English Language Learner & Multilingual Achievement (ELLMA) Department
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Amendment No. A-1, Agreement No. 17-1016, between District and California Department of Social Services, accepting amended terms of Agreement as delineated in Sections 2, 3 including an extension of time from August 18, 2018 through June 20, 2020 to June 13, 2021, allowing District to continue to provide services to newcomer refugee and unaccompanied minor students (“student refugees “) in OUSD, utilizing unexpended monies of the $1,835,520.00 Grant (initially awarded District in August 16, 2018), in California Newcomer Education and Well-Being Funds, via the English Learner and Multilingual Achievement Department. All other terms and conditions of the Agreement remain in full force and effect.
funding_source: California Department of Social Services, Refugee Programs Bureau Grant
headline: Extends state refugee and newcomer student grant to June 2021 with no new money
summary: This amendment to a state grant from the California Department of Social Services extends the time to use the money from June 20, 2020 to June 13, 2021. The district can keep serving newcomer refugee and unaccompanied minor students with unspent money from the original $1,835,520 grant, first awarded in August 2018. The text does not say how much remains unspent.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Professional Services Contract - Legacy Leaders, LLC - Elementary Network 2
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Professional Services Contract between the District and Legacy Leaders, LLC, Oakland, CA, for the latter to supply Denise Saddler to serve as an interim principal at Sankofa Academy, including performing the activities and services described in the Scope of Work, incorporated herein by reference as though fully set forth, via Elementary Network 2, for the period of December 2, 2019 through May 29, 2020, in an amount not to exceed $58,800.00.
headline: Pays Legacy Leaders up to $58,800 for an interim principal at Sankofa Academy
summary: Legacy Leaders, LLC supplies an interim principal for Sankofa Academy through the Elementary Network 2 office. The contract is for up to $58,800 and covers December 2, 2019 through May 29, 2020. The service began before the Board's approval.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Professional Services Contract - Blue Thistle Consulting - Community Schools and Student Services Department
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Professional Services Contract between the District and Blue Thistle Consulting, Orinda, CA, for the latter to create a comprehensive workflow and transition timeline document for Kindergarten Readiness Program Manager leaving the role, which captures the responsibilities, structure, timeline, partnerships, etc., of the program and its manager for program quality and future expansion, via Community Schools and Student Services Department, for the period of February 18, 2020 through June 30, 2020, in an amount not to exceed $2,250.00.
headline: Pays Blue Thistle Consulting up to $2,250 to document the Kindergarten Readiness Program
summary: Blue Thistle Consulting will write a workflow and transition timeline for the Kindergarten Readiness Program, because its manager is leaving the role. The document covers the program's responsibilities, structure, timeline and partnerships, to support quality and future growth. The contract is for up to $2,250 and covers February 18 to June 30, 2020, so the Board is approving it after work began.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Professional Services Contract - Mills Teacher Scholars - Community Schools and Student Services Department
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Professional Services Contract between the District and Mills Teacher Scholars, Oakland, CA, for the latter to facilitate a strategic planning retreat for the District's Expanded Learning staff on February 10th and February 11th on the Mills College Campus;  work with Expanded Learning staff to develop agenda for retreat and strategic objectives prior to retreat as well as reflecting with Expanded Learning team after retreat, via Community Schools and Student Services Department, for the period of February 6, 2020 through February 28, 2020, in an amount not to exceed $6,500.00.
headline: Pays Mills Teacher Scholars up to $6,500 to run an Expanded Learning staff retreat
summary: Mills Teacher Scholars facilitates a two-day strategic planning retreat for the district's Expanded Learning (after-school) staff on February 10 and 11, 2020, at the Mills College campus. It also helps plan the agenda beforehand and reflects with the team afterward. The contract is for up to $6,500 and ran February 6 to 28, 2020, so the Board is approving it after the retreat took place.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Grant Award - California Department of Education - California Partnership Academies (CPA) Program – Skyline High School Renewable Energy Academy - High School Linked Learning Office

headline: Accepts a $50,000 state grant for Skyline High School's Renewable Energy Academy
summary: The district accepts a $50,000 California Partnership Academies career technical education grant from the California Department of Education. The money supports the Renewable Energy Academy at Skyline High School. The grant period is March 1, 2020 through March 1, 2021.

summary: This resolution officially proclaims April 20-24, 2020 as Oakland Adult and Career Education Week in the district. It has no fiscal impact.

title: In-Lieu of Proposition 39 Facilities Use Agreement - American Indian Public High School - School Year 2020-2021
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of an In Lieu of Proposition 39 Facilities Use Agreement between the District and American Indian Public High School, a Charter School, for the use of a portion of the premises of the Lakeview School Site, specified in the Agreement, at 746 Grand Ave., Oakland, CA 94610, for a one-year term, for the period July 1, 2020 through June 30, 2021, for the sole purpose of operating its educational program for grades 9-12, paying District the Proposition 39 2020-2021 Use Fee specified in Section 3 of the Agreement (anticipated to be $151,099.72) and pursuant to all other terms and conditions of the Agreement.
headline: Lets American Indian Public High School use part of the Lakeview site for about $151,100
summary: American Indian Public High School, a charter school, will use part of the Lakeview School Site to run its grades 9-12 program in 2020-21. It pays the district a Proposition 39 use fee, anticipated to be $151,099.72. The agreement runs July 1, 2020 through June 30, 2021.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
